positive_rule: At least one numeric LiFD >0 in published Table S3. Do not add thresholds or select by model outcome.
background: Uniquely mapped genes appearing in Table S3, excluding all original 17 positives; background remains unlabelled, not proven negative. This is mutation-ascertained background, not complete exome coverage.
identity: Use pinned approved/unique previous HGNC symbols; exact gene-universe mapping only.
metrics: Observed-label AP, fractional tie-adjusted top100/500 recall and one-sided positive mean-rank enrichment
multiplicity: Holm across four primary model rank-enrichment tests; control descriptive
secondary: Report overlap with 80 MSK evidence genes, do not pool studies.
limits: Johns Hopkins autopsy cohort; cross-study identity not verified. LiFD computational evidence combines existing databases/predictors, not experimental proof. Source never used in fitting; original unlabelled genes were present in training.
